name: Momose Sakie
source:
A housewife who moved in to the apartment next door to the protagonist over a month ago, she is gentle woman who treats everyone kindly.
She and her salary man husband are newlyweds and she loves him very much, however because he comes home from work late at night she is finding it hard to manage her sexual desire.
